description: Captures the reference Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 shareware startup sequence as observed from reference stdout. The same 15-step initialization order was previously recorded in src/oracles/referenceRunManifest.ts INIT_SEQUENCE_LENGTH; this artifact pins it as an oracle-lane capture so downstream comparison tests can assert the host's startup phase order against vanilla.
captureMethod: Observed reference stdout from a Chocolate Doom 2.2.1 launch of doom/DOOM.EXE -iwad doom/DOOM1.WAD; sequence is the printed Z_Init / V_Init / M_LoadDefaults / W_Init / I_Init / OPL_Init / NET_Init / M_Init / R_Init / P_Init / S_Init / D_CheckNetGame / HU_Init / ST_Init / I_InitStretchTables phase labels in their printed order.
